map.由逸出功求截止频率工具依据 f₀=φ/h 由金属逸出功（eV）求光电效应截止频率: The threshold frequency from work function tool uses f0 = phi/h to derive the photoelectric threshold frequency from a metal's work function (eV), suited to photoelectric effect and quantum physics exercises.
map.输入逸出功 φ（eV），求截止频率。: Enter the work function phi (eV) to get the threshold frequency.
map.判定能否产生光电子。: Determine whether photoelectrons can be produced.
map.逸出功与波长对应。: The correspondence between work function and wavelength.
map.：f_0=Φ/h=4.5×1.602e-19/6.626e-34=1.09e15: f_0 = Phi/h = 4.5 x 1.602e-19/6.626e-34 = 1.09e15 Hz, corresponding to lambda_0 = 276nm (ultraviolet).
map.：f_0=5.57e14 Hz，λ_0=538nm，可见光即可打出电子。: f_0 = 5.57e14 Hz and lambda_0 = 538nm, so visible light can knock out electrons.
map.由功率与波长求每秒光子数: Photons per Second from Power and Wavelength
map.由能级与频率求能量: Derive Energy from Energy Level and Frequency
map.λ_0=hc/Φ=1240/Φ(eV) nm；功函数越大截止波长越短。: lambda_0 = hc/Phi = 1240/Phi(eV) nm; the larger the work function, the shorter the cutoff wavelength.
map.金属为何多需紫外？: Why do metals mostly require ultraviolet light?
map.多数金属 Φ>3eV，故 λ_0 在紫外区。: For most metals Phi > 3eV, so lambda_0 falls in the ultraviolet.
